titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Weather, climate and experiences: Essential vocabulary

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Weather, climate and experiences. Focus: Vocabulary.

texto: Essential vocabulary on weather and experiences: «ฝนตก» (fǒn-dtòk, to rain, lit. rain falls), «อากาศ» (ʔaa-kàat, weather / climate / air), «ร้อน» (rɔ́ɔn, hot / warm) and «สนุก» (sà-nùk, fun / enjoyable). To express cause and consequence, «เพราะ...จึง...» (because..., therefore...) is used: «เมื่อวานฝนตก เราจึงอยู่บ้าน» (Yesterday it rained, so we stayed at home). To contrast impressions, «แต่» (but): «อากาศร้อนแต่การเดินทางสนุก» (It was hot, but the trip was fun). To ask about past experiences: «เคย...ไหม» (have you ever...?): «คุณเคยไปเชียงใหม่ไหม» (Have you ever been to Chiang Mai?).

opciones.texto: The weather forecast helps you take an umbrella or raincoat when you go out.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การพยากรณ์อากาศช่วยให้ประชาชนเตรียมร่มหรือเสื้อกันฝนก่อนออกจากบ้าน» from the text.

opciones.texto: The monsoon season brings greenery to the forests and farmland.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The daytime heat makes drinking cool water an ideal way to cool down.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.
